requests.prompt: Review the working tree changes. When your environment supports independent sub-agents, use the optional multi-agent decomposition guidance and reconcile the results before responding.
作業ツリーの変更をコードレビューしてください。実行環境が独立したサブエージェントに対応している場合は、任意の複数エージェント分解ガイドを使用し、結果を統合してから回答してください。

must_report: The new value < 1 && value > 100 condition is impossible, so out-of-range integer limits are accepted despite the documented 1 through 100 contract.
The new truthy role check lets every member view records owned by another user, despite the documented rule that only admins may do so.
must_not_report: Lose either independently demonstrated defect during final reconciliation.
Report the same root defect more than once under different action levels or viewpoints.
Treat a delegated verifier's conclusion as evidence without inspecting its cited code or recorded check.
Manufacture a finding for the correct display-name normalization change.
